• Du unterstützt die Group General Counsel und das Legal Team bei ausgewählten organisatorischen Themen (externe Dienstleistungen, Rechnungen, Spesen, Legal Events, Termine etc.).

Erforderliche Fachkenntnisse

• Du verfügst über eine der folgenden Qualifikationen: eine kaufmännische Ausbildung mit relevantem juristischem Hintergrund und/oder einer Paralegal-Weiterbildung, einen Bachelor of Law oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

• Du hast bereits in einer ähnlichen Rolle gearbeitet, beispielsweise in einem Notariat, einer Rechtsabteilung, als Corporate Secretary oder in einer wirtschaftsrechtlich ausgerichteten Kanzlei.

• Du bringst ein gutes Verständnis für Corporate Governance und gesellschaftsrechtliche Dokumente mit und kannst diese selbstständig, sorgfältig und zuverlässig bearbeiten.

• Du arbeitest strukturiert, denkst voraus und behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Themen den Überblick.

• Du gehst mit vertraulichen Informationen selbstverständlich diskret um und überzeugst durch Präzision, Verlässlichkeit und einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch.

• Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift und kommunizierst auch auf Englisch sicher, sodass du dich im internationalen Austausch mit Gruppengesellschaften und externen Ansprechpartnern problemlos verständigen kannst.

• Du arbeitest gerne eigenständig, suchst bei Bedarf aktiv den Austausch und bringst unterschiedliche Beteiligte effizient zusammen.

• Du schätzt eine Rolle, in der du Verantwortung übernehmen, rechtliche Themen verstehen und einen konkreten Beitrag zum Funktionieren einer globalen Corporate Governance leisten kannst.

Mach den nächsten Schritt und werde Teil unseres Legal Teams. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Menschen bei Belimo

Intelligente Gebäude entstehen durch engagierte Menschen. Wir bringen talentierte Menschen zusammen und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem sie erfolgreich sein können. Bei Belimo tragen Respekt, Vertrauen und gegenseitige Unterstützung über Abteilungsgrenzen hinweg dazu bei, dass aus Ideen rasch praktische Lösungen werden. Denn gemeinsam erreichen wir mehr, als wir alleine je erreichen könnten.

Über Belimo

Belimo ist Weltmarktführer in Entwicklung, Herstellung und Vertrieb von Feldgeräten zur energieeffizienten Regelung von Heizungs-, Lüftungs- und Klimaanlagen. Klappenantriebe, Regelventile, Sensoren und Zähler bilden dabei unser Kerngeschäft. Das 1975 gegründete Unternehmen ist seit 1995 an der Schweizer Börse (SIX) kotiert.

Vergütung und Zusatzleistungen

Wir bei Belimo glauben an eine faire, gerechte und wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung. Wir bieten ein Gehalt, das deinen Fähigkeiten, deiner Erfahrung, deiner Ausbildung und deinem Einsatzort entspricht. Neben der Vergütung profitierst du von umfassenden Zusatzleistungen, die dein mentales, körperliches, finanzielles und soziales Wohlbefinden unterstützen. Belimo ist stolz darauf, eine Arbeitgeberin zu sein, die Chancengleichheit fördert.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Présentation

Voulez-vous contribuer à un rôle à temps partiel diversifié dans une relation internationale? Chez Belimo, vous soutenez le Conseiller Général et l'Équipe juridique dans les questions de gouvernance d'entreprise du Groupe Belimo tout en assumant vos propres tâches de manière indépendante.

Si vous aimez traiter de questions d'ordre administratif et de gouvernance de votre propre chef et en élaborer des solutions claires et réalisables, vous aurez un rôle responsable avec de nombreuses tâches et coopération internationale.

Principales responsabilités

- Vous soutenez le conseil général du groupe dans le développement de la gouvernance d'entreprise, fournissez des informations juridiques et des bases de décision et appliquez les mesures nécessaires de façon indépendante conformément aux exigences du conseil général du groupe.
- Vous vous assurez que les documents, les entrées et les renseignements importants relatifs au droit des sociétés sont tenus à jour et structurés de façon complète.
- Vous travaillez avec des sociétés de groupes internationales, des services internes, des avocats externes, des notaires et des autorités et coordonnez les prochaines étapes pertinentes.
- Vous disposerez du tableau de groupe ainsi que de vues d'ensemble sur les questions juridiques, en particulier les litiges et les conseils juridiques externes.
- Vous coordonnez les enregistrements d'entreprises, les déclarations, les certifications et les légalisations pour les entreprises du groupe suisse.
- Vous développerez la présence intranet légale basée sur SharePoint indépendamment et coordonnerez la communication interne correspondante.
- Vous soutenez le conseiller général du groupe et l'équipe juridique dans certains sujets organisationnels (services externes, factures, dépenses, événements juridiques, nominations, etc.).

Compétences requises

- Vous avez l'une des qualifications suivantes : une formation commerciale avec un bagage juridique pertinent et/ou une formation complémentaire parajuridique, un baccalauréat en droit ou une qualification comparable.
- Vous avez déjà travaillé dans un rôle similaire, par exemple dans un notaire, un département juridique, comme secrétaire d'entreprise ou dans un cabinet d'avocats.
- Vous apportez une bonne compréhension de la gouvernance d'entreprise et des documents de droit des sociétés et pouvez les traiter de façon indépendante, soigneusement et fiable.
- Vous travaillez de façon structurée, réfléchissez et conservez un aperçu de plusieurs sujets parallèles.
- Vous manipulez discrètement des informations confidentielles et vous convainquez par la précision, la fiabilité et un standard de qualité élevé.
- Vous avez de très bonnes compétences en allemand en paroles et en écriture et vous communiquez en toute sécurité en anglais, afin que vous puissiez communiquer facilement dans les échanges internationaux avec les entreprises de groupe et les personnes-ressources externes.
- Vous aimez travailler de façon indépendante, rechercher activement l'échange si nécessaire et efficacement rassembler les différents acteurs.
- Vous appréciez un rôle dans lequel vous pouvez prendre des responsabilités, comprendre les questions juridiques et apporter une contribution concrète au fonctionnement de la gouvernance d'entreprise mondiale.

Prenez la prochaine étape et devenez membre de notre équipe juridique. Nous avons hâte de vous rencontrer!

Les gens de Belimo

Nous réunissons des gens talentueux et créons un environnement dans lequel ils peuvent réussir. Chez Belimo, le respect, la confiance et le soutien mutuel au-delà des frontières ministérielles contribuent à faire des idées rapidement des solutions pratiques. Ensemble, nous obtenons plus que nous ne pourrions jamais atteindre par nous-mêmes.

À propos de Belimo

Belimo est le leader mondial dans le développement, la fabrication et la distribution d'équipements de terrain pour le contrôle énergétique des systèmes de chauffage, ventilation et climatisation. Les entraînements de vannes, les vannes de commande, les capteurs et les compteurs forment notre activité principale. Fondée en 1975, Belimo est cotée à la Bourse suisse (SIX) depuis 1995.

Rémunération et services supplémentaires

Chez Belimo, nous croyons en une rémunération juste et compétitive. Nous offrons un salaire qui correspond à vos compétences, expérience, formation et où vous êtes. En plus de la rémunération, vous bénéficiez d'avantages globaux qui soutiennent votre bien-être mental, physique, financier et social. Belimo est fier d'être un employeur qui favorise l'égalité des chances.

Introduzione

L'esperienza di esportazione incontra la leadership: In questo ruolo chiave, si guida un team dedicato, garantire processi e sistemi di esportazione internazionali professionali.

Principali responsabilità

• Guida il tuo team, motiva e sviluppa i tuoi dipendenti e insieme a loro assicura un processo di esportazione affidabile e di alta qualità.

• Sei responsabile della gestione mondiale delle spedizioni di merci e documenti tra cui tutti i documenti necessari per l'esportazione e la dogana, certificati di origine, certificazioni, carnet ATA/free pass e trasmissione elettronica e manuale a spedizionieri, uffici doganali e clienti.

• È possibile creare e controllare i certificati di accettazione e i certificati di materiale, mantenere i dati master necessari e il supporto durante i processi di importazione, in particolare nelle consegne di restituzione e nelle spedizioni di riparazione.

• In qualità di referente competente, si occuperà di questioni relative a dogana, controllo delle esportazioni e commercio estero e formare le nostre società del Gruppo nei processi di esportazione, così come in SAP GTS e SAP EWM.

• Continuerete a sviluppare i nostri processi di esportazione, soluzioni di sistema, istruzioni di lavoro e documenti di formazione e garantire la documentazione strutturata e l'archiviazione in conformità con ISO 9001:2000 e ISO 14001:2000.

• Tenere d'occhio qualità, scadenze e costi, avviare misure appropriate in caso di deviazioni e garantire il rispetto dei requisiti di tempo di lavoro, vacanza, assenza e sicurezza del lavoro. Questo include anche la pianificazione delle vacanze e la manutenzione dei spedizionieri nel sistema ERP.

• Nel vostro ruolo di leadership, insieme al vostro manager e alle risorse umane, assumete i processi e le decisioni del personale pertinenti, dagli accordi di destinazione e dalle valutazioni dei dipendenti alle discussioni sui bonus e sui salari, e assicurate un ambiente di lavoro sicuro attraverso le valutazioni dei rischi e le misure corrispondenti.

Competenza necessaria

• Hai una formazione commerciale di base e una formazione specialistica superiore in esportazione e/o commercio estero, idealmente come specialista del commercio estero con un certificato professionale federale o manager del commercio estero.

• Avrai almeno cinque anni di esperienza professionale nell'ambiente industriale, commerciale o logistico internazionale e conosci il processo operativo di esportazione e i suoi requisiti dalla pratica.

• Hai già guadagnato almeno due anni di esperienza di leadership, condurre con chiarezza e apprezzamento e capire come motivare e sviluppare i dipendenti.

• Lei è SAP-savvy e ha una conoscenza IT molto buona, soprattutto in SAP SD, MM, PP, EWM e BI così come MS Office.

• Porti la logistica e l'esperienza di progetto, pensi ai confini divisionali e sviluppi soluzioni con una visione a medio e lungo termine.

• Convinci con il pensiero imprenditoriale, l'iniziativa e la forza di comunicazione, lavori con precisione e affidabilità anche sotto la pressione del termine e vinci su diversi gruppi di stakeholder per soluzioni comuni.

• Si comunica in tedesco e inglese, godere di lavorare come squadra e sono impegnati, impegnati e convincenti.

Persone a Belimo

Gli edifici intelligenti sono creati da persone impegnate. Portiamo insieme persone di talento e creiamo un ambiente in cui possono avere successo. A Belimo, il rispetto, la fiducia e il sostegno reciproco attraverso i confini dipartimentali aiutano a trasformare rapidamente le idee in soluzioni pratiche. Insieme riusciamo a raggiungere più di quanto potremmo mai raggiungere da soli.

Informazioni su Belimo

Belimo è leader mondiale nello sviluppo, nella produzione e nella vendita di dispositivi di campo per il controllo efficiente dell'impianto di riscaldamento, ventilazione e condizionamento dell'aria. Azionatrici, valvole di controllo, sensori e metri formano il nostro core business. Fondata nel 1975, la società è quotata in Borsa svizzera (SIX) dal 1995.

Remunerazione e benefici aggiuntivi

A Belimo, crediamo in una compensazione equa, giusta e competitiva. Offriamo uno stipendio che corrisponde alle tue competenze, esperienza, istruzione e posizione. Oltre alla compensazione, si beneficia di servizi aggiuntivi completi che supportano il vostro benessere mentale, fisico, finanziario e sociale. Belimo è orgogliosa di essere un datore di lavoro che promuove pari opportunità.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction

Export expertise meets leadership: In this key role, you lead a dedicated team, ensure professional international export processing and drive processes and systems forward.

Main responsibilities

• You lead your team, motivate and develop your employees and together with them ensure a reliable and high-quality export process.

• You are responsible for the worldwide handling of shipments of goods and documents including all necessary export and customs documents, certificates of origin, certifications, ATA carnet/free passes as well as electronic and manual transmission to forwarders, customs offices and customers.

• You create and check acceptance certificates and material certificates, maintain the necessary master data and support during import processes, in particular in return deliveries and repair shipments.

• As a competent contact person, you will deal with issues relating to customs, export control and foreign trade and train our Group companies in export processes as well as in SAP GTS and SAP EWM.

• You will continue to develop our export processes, system solutions, work instructions and training documents and ensure structured documentation and archiving in accordance with ISO 9001:2000 and ISO 14001:2000.

• You keep an eye on quality, deadlines and costs, initiate appropriate measures in the event of deviations and ensure compliance with working time, holiday, absence and work safety requirements. This also includes holiday planning and the maintenance of freight forwarders in the ERP system.

• In your leadership role, together with your manager and HR, you take on the relevant personnel processes and decisions, from target agreements and employee assessments to bonus and wage discussions, and ensure a safe working environment through risk assessments and corresponding measures.

Required expertise

• You have a basic commercial training and a higher specialist training in export and/or foreign trade, ideally as a foreign trade specialist with a federal professional certificate or foreign trade manager.

• You will have at least five years of professional experience in the international industrial, commercial or logistics environment and know the operational export processing and its requirements from practice.

• You have already gained at least two years of leadership experience, lead with clarity and appreciation and understand how to motivate and develop employees.

• You are SAP-savvy and have very good IT knowledge, especially in SAP SD, MM, PP, EWM and BI as well as MS Office.

• You bring logistics and project experience, think across divisional boundaries and develop solutions with a medium- and long-term view.

• You convince with entrepreneurial thinking, initiative and communication strength, work accurately and reliably even under deadline pressure and win over different stakeholder groups for joint solutions.

• You communicate in German and English, enjoy working as a team and are committed, committed and convincing.

People at Belimo

Intelligent buildings are created by committed people. We bring talented people together and create an environment where they can succeed. At Belimo, respect, trust and mutual support across departmental boundaries help turn ideas quickly into practical solutions. Together we achieve more than we could ever achieve alone.

About Belimo

Belimo is the world market leader in the development, manufacture and sale of field devices for energy-efficient control of heating, ventilation and air conditioning systems. Flap drives, control valves, sensors and meters form our core business. Founded in 1975, the company has been listed on the Swiss Stock Exchange (SIX) since 1995.

Remuneration and additional benefits

At Belimo, we believe in fair, fair and competitive compensation. We offer a salary that matches your skills, experience, education and location. In addition to the compensation, you benefit from comprehensive additional services that support your mental, physical, financial and social well-being. Belimo is proud to be an employer promoting equal opportunities.

• Vous continuerez à développer nos processus d'exportation, solutions système, instructions de travail et documents de formation et vous assurerez la documentation structurée et l'archivage conformément aux normes ISO 9001:2000 et ISO 14001:2000.

• Vous gardez un œil sur la qualité, les délais et les coûts, prenez les mesures appropriées en cas d'écarts et assurez le respect des exigences en matière de temps de travail, de vacances, d'absence et de sécurité au travail. Cela comprend également la planification des vacances et la maintenance des transitaires dans le système ERP.

• Vous avez déjà acquis au moins deux ans d'expérience en leadership, dirigez avec clarté et appréciation et comprenez comment motiver et développer les employés.

• Vous êtes SAP-savvy et avez de très bonnes connaissances en informatique, en particulier dans SAP SD, MM, PP, EWM et BI ainsi que MS Office.

• Vous apportez une expérience logistique et de projet, pensez au-delà des frontières de division et développez des solutions avec une vue à moyen et long terme.

• Vous convainquez avec la pensée entrepreneuriale, l'initiative et la force de communication, travaillez avec précision et fiabilité même sous la pression des délais et gagnez les différents groupes d'intervenants pour des solutions conjointes.

• Vous communiquez en allemand et en anglais, aimez travailler en équipe et êtes engagé, engagé et convaincant.

Les gens de Belimo

Les bâtiments intelligents sont créés par des personnes engagées. Nous réunissons des gens talentueux et créons un environnement où ils peuvent réussir. Chez Belimo, le respect, la confiance et le soutien mutuel au-delà des frontières ministérielles aident à transformer rapidement les idées en solutions pratiques. Ensemble, nous obtenons plus que nous n'aurions jamais pu atteindre seuls.

À propos de Belimo

Belimo est le leader mondial dans le développement, la fabrication et la vente de dispositifs de terrain pour le contrôle énergétique des systèmes de chauffage, de ventilation et de climatisation. Les moteurs à flamme, les vannes de commande, les capteurs et les compteurs forment notre activité principale. Fondée en 1975, la société est cotée à la Bourse suisse (SIX) depuis 1995.

Rémunération et prestations supplémentaires

Chez Belimo, nous croyons en une rémunération juste, équitable et concurrentielle. Nous offrons un salaire qui correspond à vos compétences, expérience, éducation et emplacement. En plus de la rémunération, vous bénéficiez de services supplémentaires complets qui soutiennent votre bien-être mental, physique, financier et social. Belimo est fier d'être un employeur qui favorise l'égalité des chances.

jobs.description:
Einführung

Du gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unserer Logistikorganisation in einer dynamischen Wachstums- und Veränderungsphase aktiv mit. Dabei entwickelst du Strukturen, Prozesse und Führung konsequent weiter und stärkst klare Verantwortlichkeiten sowie die Eigenständigkeit unserer Teamleitenden. Gemeinsam schafft ihr die Voraussetzungen für effiziente Abläufe, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und einen stabilen Logistikbetrieb.

Hauptverantwortlichkeiten

• Führung & Change: Du entwickelst deine Teamleitenden gezielt zu starken, eigenverantwortlichen Führungskräften, verlagerst operative Verantwortung bewusst ins Team und begleitest die Logistikorganisation (rund 80 Mitarbeitende) gleichzeitig durch eine dynamische Wachstumsphase.

• Leistung, Qualität und Kosten im Griff: Du verantwortest das Budget der Teams Warenannahme, Lagerung, Kommissionierung, Entsorgung und Versand.

•
 Du steuerst die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Logistikprozesse anhand relevanter KPI und BSC-Reports und stellst Qualität, Effizienz und KVP sicher. Dazu gehören auch die strategische Planung von Investitionen und deren nachhaltige Instandhaltung.

• Personal- und Einsatzplanung: Du trägst die Gesamtverantwortung für eine effiziente Ressourcen-, Schicht- und Notfallplanung im 24/7-Schichtbetrieb; die operative Steuerung liegt bei deinen Teamleitenden.

• Technik & Anlagenbetrieb: Du stellst die Verfügbarkeit aller Anlagen sicher (inkl. hochautomatisiertem Hochregal- und Kleinteilelager und externem Aussenlager).

• HSSE & Compliance leben: Arbeitssicherheit, Gesundheit, Umwelt, gesetzliche Vorgaben, ISO-Standards und interne Richtlinien – Du hältst alles ein und entwickelst es weiter.

• Qualität & Projekte: Unterstützung bei Qualitätsfällen, Prozessmitteilungen und aktive Teilnahme an relevanten Projekten.

Erforderliche Fachkenntnisse

• Langjährige Führungserfahrung mit Verantwortung für grosse Teams (mind. 80 Personen) sowie der Fähigkeit, Teams und Führungskräfte in einem dynamischen Wachstumsfeld zu begleiten und weiterzuentwickeln

• Mind. 10 Jahre Berufserfahrung in internationalen Industrie-, Handels- oder Logistikunternehmen im Bereich Operations mit Fokus auf Logistik

• Fundierte Aus- und Weiterbildung in Logistik/Supply Chain Management (HF, FH oder vergleichbar)

• Fundierte Erfahrung in der erfolgreichen Umsetzung von Change Management, Organisations- und Führungsentwicklung sowie in Operational Excellence und bereichsübergreifenden Transformationsprojekten

• Teamplayer mit Durchsetzungsstärke: starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Konfliktkompetenz und Entscheidungsstärke

• Sehr gute IT- und SAP-Kenntnisse (SD, MM, PP, EWM) und sichere Kommunikation in Deutsch (mind. C1) und Englisch (mind. B2)

Menschen bei Belimo

Intelligente Gebäude entstehen durch engagierte Menschen. Wir bringen talentierte Menschen zusammen und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem sie erfolgreich sein können. Bei Belimo tragen Respekt, Vertrauen und gegenseitige Unterstützung über Abteilungsgrenzen hinweg dazu bei, dass aus Ideen rasch praktische Lösungen werden. Denn gemeinsam erreichen wir mehr, als wir alleine je erreichen könnten.

Über Belimo

Belimo ist Weltmarktführer in Entwicklung, Herstellung und Vertrieb von Feldgeräten zur energieeffizienten Regelung von Heizungs-, Lüftungs- und Klimaanlagen. Klappenantriebe, Regelventile, Sensoren und Zähler bilden dabei unser Kerngeschäft. Das 1975 gegründete Unternehmen ist seit 1995 an der Schweizer Börse (SIX) kotiert.

Vergütung und Zusatzleistungen

Wir bei Belimo glauben an eine faire, gerechte und wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung. Wir bieten ein Gehalt, das deinen Fähigkeiten, deiner Erfahrung, deiner Ausbildung und deinem Einsatzort entspricht. Neben der Vergütung profitierst du von umfassenden Zusatzleistungen, die dein mentales, körperliches, finanzielles und soziales Wohlbefinden unterstützen. Belimo ist stolz darauf, eine Arbeitgeberin zu sein, die Chancengleichheit fördert.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione

Guidate e allenate i vostri team attraverso una forte fase di crescita, ottimizzate i processi e tenete in funzione il nostro mondo della logistica – dal ricevimento delle merci ai robot high-bay. Se ti senti come assumere la leadership, padroneggiare i processi e guidare l'innovazione, sei al posto giusto con noi.

Principali responsabilità

• Guidare, motivare, sviluppare: rafforzare e sviluppare i vostri leader e dipendenti del team (totale circa 80 dipendenti), promuovere competenze di leadership e accompagnare l'organizzazione attraverso una fase di crescita dinamica.

• Personale di masterizzazione e pianificazione delle assegnazioni: Pianificazione ottimale dei turni (3 turni), gestione delle emergenze e gestione delle risorse sono nelle vostre mani.

• Prestazioni, qualità e costi sotto controllo: Lei è responsabile per la ricevuta di merci, lo stoccaggio, la raccolta, lo smaltimento e la spedizione – compresi i bilanci, l'inventario e la gestione dell'inventario.

• Tecnologia e funzionamento degli impianti: Garantisci la disponibilità di tutti gli impianti (inclusi i magazzini di alta sicurezza e piccole parti altamente automatizzati e il magazzino esterno).

• Ottimizzazione dei processi logistici: Qualità ed efficienza – Sviluppi ulteriormente i processi, proteggi i beni di capitale e garantisci la loro manutenzione sostenibile e il miglioramento continuo nel senso del CIP.

• HSSE & compliance living: sicurezza del lavoro, salute, ambiente, requisiti legali, norme ISO e linee guida interne – Tieni tutto e lo sviluppi ulteriormente.

• Reporting & Control: Le relazioni statistiche, KPI e BSC costituiscono la base per il monitoraggio continuo e il miglioramento delle prestazioni logistiche.

• Qualità & Progetti: Supporto per casi di qualità, comunicazioni di processo e partecipazione attiva a progetti rilevanti.

Competenza necessaria

• Formazione professionale tecnica o logistica completa (ad es. logistica/EFZ) e formazione specialistica superiore nella logistica

• Molti anni di esperienza manageriale con responsabilità per grandi squadre (almeno 80 persone) e la capacità di accompagnare e sviluppare team e manager in un campo di crescita dinamico

• Mente. 10 anni di esperienza professionale in aziende industriali, commerciali o logistiche internazionali nel campo delle operazioni con focus sulla logistica

• Esperienza approfondita nella riuscita realizzazione di iniziative di eccellenza operativa, ottimizzazione dei processi, gestione dei cambiamenti e progetti di trasformazione trasversale

• Molto buone competenze IT e SAP (SD, MM, PP, EWM) e comunicazione sicura in tedesco (minimo C1) e inglese (minimo B2)

• pensiero imprenditoriale, piacere decisionale e alta indipendenza

• Team player con assertività: forti capacità di comunicazione, competenza di conflitto, affidabilità e metodi di lavoro strutturati

• Prerequisiti pratici: test di stacker elettrodo e prontezza per il lavoro a turni

Persone a Belimo

Gli edifici intelligenti sono creati da persone impegnate. Portiamo insieme persone di talento e creiamo un ambiente in cui possono avere successo. A Belimo, il rispetto, la fiducia e il sostegno reciproco attraverso i confini dipartimentali aiutano a trasformare rapidamente le idee in soluzioni pratiche. Insieme riusciamo a raggiungere più di quanto potremmo mai raggiungere da soli.

About Belimo

Belimo è leader mondiale nello sviluppo, nella produzione e nella vendita di dispositivi da campo per il controllo efficiente dell'impianto di riscaldamento, ventilazione e condizionamento dell'aria. Azionatrici, valvole di controllo, sensori e metri formano il nostro core business. Fondata nel 1975, la società è quotata sulla Borsa Svizzera (SIX) dal 1995.

Remunerazione e benefici aggiuntivi

A Belimo, crediamo in una compensazione equa, giusta e competitiva. Offriamo uno stipendio che corrisponde alle tue competenze, esperienza, istruzione e posizione. Oltre alla compensazione, si beneficia di servizi aggiuntivi completi che supportano il vostro benessere mentale, fisico, finanziario e sociale. Belimo è orgogliosa di essere un datore di lavoro che promuove pari opportunità.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction

You lead and coach your teams through a strong growth phase, optimize processes and keep our logistics world running – from goods receipt to high-bay robots. If you feel like taking on leadership, mastering processes and driving innovation, you are at the right place with us.

Main responsibilities

• Lead, motivate, develop: You strengthen and develop your team leaders and employees (total about 80 employees), promote leadership skills and accompany the organization through a dynamic growth phase.

• Mastering personnel and assignment planning: Optimal shift planning (3-shift operation), emergency management and resource management are in your hands.

• Performance, quality and costs under control: You are responsible for goods receipt, storage, picking, disposal and shipping – including budgets, inventory and inventory management.

• Technology & plant operation: You ensure the availability of all plants (including highly automated high-bay and small parts warehouse and external external warehouse).

• Optimizing logistics processes: Quality and efficiency – You develop processes further, procure capital goods and ensure their sustainable maintenance and continuous improvement in the sense of the CIP.

• HSSE & compliance living: occupational safety, health, environment, legal requirements, ISO standards and internal guidelines – You keep everything and develop it further.

• Reporting & Control: Statistics, KPI and BSC reports serve as the basis for continuously monitoring and improving logistics performance.

• Quality & Projects: Support for quality cases, process communications and active participation in relevant projects.

Required expertise

• Completed technical or logistical vocational training (e.g. logistician/EFZ) plus higher specialist training in logistics

• Many years of management experience with responsibility for large teams (at least 80 people) as well as the ability to accompany and develop teams and managers in a dynamic growth field

• Mind. 10 years of professional experience in international industrial, commercial or logistics companies in the field of operations with focus on logistics

• In-depth experience in the successful implementation of operational excellence initiatives, process optimization, change management and cross-divisional transformation projects

• Very good IT and SAP skills (SD, MM, PP, EWM) and secure communication in German (minimum C1) and English (minimum B2)

• Entrepreneurial thinking, decision-making pleasure and high independence

• Team player with assertiveness: strong communication skills, conflict competence, reliability and structured working methods

• Practical prerequisites: electrode stacker testing and readiness for shift work

People at Belimo

Intelligent buildings are created by committed people. We bring talented people together and create an environment where they can succeed. At Belimo, respect, trust and mutual support across departmental boundaries help turn ideas into practical solutions quickly. Together we achieve more than we could ever achieve alone.

About Belimo

Belimo is the world market leader in the development, manufacture and sale of field devices for energy-efficient control of heating, ventilation and air conditioning systems. Flap drives, control valves, sensors and meters form our core business. Founded in 1975, the company has been listed on the Swiss Stock Exchange (SIX) since 1995.

Remuneration and additional benefits

At Belimo, we believe in fair, fair and competitive compensation. We offer a salary that matches your skills, experience, education and location. In addition to the compensation, you benefit from comprehensive additional services that support your mental, physical, financial and social well-being. Belimo is proud to be an employer who promotes equal opportunities.

jobs.description:
Du willst komplexe Produktionsanlagen nicht nur zum Laufen bringen, sondern kontinuierlich besser machen ? Bei uns verbindest Du technisches Expertenwissen mit modernen digitalen Technologien und KI und gestaltest die Zukunft unseres Manufacturing Engineering aktiv mit.

Hauptverantwortlichkeiten

• Du übernimmst die technische Verantwortung für die Inbetriebnahme, Verifizierung und Qualifizierung komplexer Produktionsanlagen und begleitest diese bis zur erfolgreichen Übergabe an die Produktion.

• Du steuerst anspruchsvolle FAT-, SAT-, IQ-, OQ- und PQ-Aktivitäten und arbeitest dabei eng mit Engineering, Produktion, Qualität, Lieferanten und unseren internationalen Standorten zusammen.

• Du begleitest Software-Deployments, Anlagen-Upgrades und Transfers und stellst sicher, dass Anlagen und Software im jeweiligen Produktionsumfeld zuverlässig funktionieren.

• Bei komplexen technischen Herausforderungen bist Du die zentrale Ansprechperson: Du führst Root-Cause-Analysen durch und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Teams nachhaltige Lösungen.

• Du unterstützt unsere Produktionsstandorte bei Ramp-ups, technischen Eskalationen sowie Modernisierungen und Lifecycle-Themen.

• Deine Erfahrungen aus Projekten und Inbetriebnahmen nutzt Du, um Deployment-Methoden, Standards, Checklisten und Prozesse kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und standortübergreifend zu harmonisieren.

• Du nutzt digitale Technologien und KI-Tools, um Störungsbehebung, Engineering, Dokumentation und Wissensmanagement kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

• Als technische:r Expert:in förderst Du den Wissensaustausch innerhalb des Manufacturing Engineering und bringst Deine Expertise in Reviews, Lessons Learned und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Methoden ein.

Erforderliche Fachkenntnisse

• Du verfügst über ein technisches Studium (FH/Uni), z. B. in Automation, Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau, Mechatronik oder Produktionstechnik. Dies kombiniert mit umfassender relevanter Praxiserfahrung.

• Du hast fundierte Erfahrung mit Produktionsanlagen, insbesondere in den Bereichen Inbetriebnahme, Verifizierung, Qualifizierung, Ramp-up und technischem Lifecycle Support.

Description

You want to make complex production plants work, but to make them better? With us, you combine technical expertise with modern digital technologies and AI and actively shape the future of our manufacturing engineering.

Main responsibilities

- You take over the technical responsibility for commissioning, verification and qualification of complex production facilities and accompany them until the successful transfer to production.
- You control demanding FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ and PQ activities and work closely with engineering, production, quality, suppliers and our international locations.
- You accompany software deployments, system upgrades and transfers and ensure that systems and software work reliably in the respective production environment.
- In complex technical challenges, you are the central contact person: You conduct root-key analysis and develop sustainable solutions together with the participating teams.
- You support our production sites in Ramp-ups, technical escalations, modernizations and life-cycle topics.
- You use your experience from projects and commissioning to continuously develop and work on deployment methods, standards, checklists and processes across locations.
- You use digital technologies and AI tools to continuously improve troubleshooting, engineering, documentation and knowledge management.
- As a technical expert:in you promote the exchange of knowledge within the field of manufacturing engineering and bring your expertise in reviews, lessons learned and the further development of our methods.

Skills required

- You have a technical degree (FH/Uni), e.g. in automation, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, mechatronics or production technology. This combines with comprehensive relevant practical experience.
- You have extensive experience with production facilities, especially in the areas of commissioning, verification, qualification, ramp-up and technical lifecycle support.
- You are a real Hands-on engineer: you like to work directly on systems and systems, get to the bottom of technical problems and also implement solutions yourself in practice.
- You have high A-resinity on AI topics – ideally also deepened experiences with them.
- You know very well about automation, system software, interfaces and qualification processes such as FAT/SAT and IQ/OQ/PQ.
- You deal with complex technical problems in an analytical and structured way and convince yourself of your own initiative, implementation strength and responsibility.
- You like to work interdisciplinaryally, pass on your knowledge and can convince and support others with your professional competence, even without disciplinary leadership responsibility.
- You communicate very well in English and are ready to travel nationally and internationally in the event of important project phases or technical challenges.

People at Belimo

Smart buildings are created by committed people. We bring together talented people and create an environment in which they can be successful. At Belimo, respect, trust and mutual support across departmental boundaries help to quickly turn ideas into practical solutions. Together, we achieve more than we could ever achieve for all.

About Belimo

Belimo is the world leader in the development, manufacture and distribution of field equipment for energy-efficient control of heating, ventilation and air conditioning systems. Valve drives, control valves, sensors and counters form our core business. Founded in 1975, Belimo has been listed on the Swiss Stock Exchange (SIX) since 1995.

Compensation & Benefits

At Belimo, we believe in fair, just and competitive remuneration. We offer a salary that matches your skills, experience, training and commitment. Besides remuneration, you profit from comprehensive benefits that support your mental, physical, financial and social well-being. Belimo is proud to be an employer that promotes equal opportunities.

jobs.title: Quality Project Manager (80 - 100%)
jobs.description:
Introduction

Are you ready to shape the quality of tomorrow’s Belimo products from the very beginning? In this role, you will act as the quality voice in global product development and change projects, ensuring that quality is planned, risks are managed early, and products are ready to perform in the real world.

What You'll Do

• Act as the quality lead and single point of contact for quality in assigned global product development and change projects, ensuring close alignment with Project Managers, Innovation, Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, Procurement, Product Management, and quality functions.

• Develop, implement, and monitor project-specific quality plans and control concepts across all PCP phases, including proactive risk identification and mitigation.

• Contribute to product and process risk assessments such as FMEA, ensuring mitigation actions are implemented and their effectiveness verified before gate approvals.

• Review specifications, design outputs, verification and validation plans and results, and production readiness; provide a clear quality-based recommendation for PCP gate approvals.

• Ensure lessons learned, warranty data, and field performance insights are systematically integrated into new and enhancement projects to prevent recurrence of known issues.

• Apply and continuously improve harmonized Group Quality methods, tools, and templates, promoting their consistent use across Innovation Hubs, regions, and plants.

• Collect, evaluate, and report project quality performance data such as defects, rework, and late changes; identify trends and initiate corrective and preventive actions.

• Support internal and external audits and assessments related to development and project processes, ensuring timely closure of deviations and adherence to ISO and internal standards.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s degree in Electronics Engineering or an equivalent technical discipline.

• Minimum 3–5 years of experience as a Project Quality Engineer, in product development, or in a comparable role within a global or multinational environment.

• Strong practical knowledge of quality tools and methods, including APQP, FMEA, PPAP, and Problem Solving.

• Certified Internal or Lead Auditor for ISO 9001; IATF 16949 or comparable standards are an advantage.

• Hands-on experience with quality management systems, testing methodologies, and technical documentation.

• Proven ability to analyze processes, identify gaps, and develop actionable improvement plans.

• Experience working effectively in cross-functional and cross-regional teams, with strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.

• Fluent English; German is an advantage. An analytical mindset, attention to detail, and confidence in navigating evolving or ambiguous environments are essential.

Ready for your next step? We look forward to hearing from you.

People at Belimo

Smart buildings start with dedicated people. We bring talented people together and foster an environment to succeed. At Belimo, respect, trust, and support across departments help ideas move quickly into real-world solutions, because we achieve more together than we ever could alone.

About Belimo

Belimo is the global market leader in the development, production, and sales of field devices for the energy-efficient control of heating, ventilation and air-conditioning systems. The focus of our core business is on damper actuators, control valves, sensors and meters. Founded in 1975, the company has been listed on the Swiss Exchange (SIX) since 1995.

Compensation & Benefits

At Belimo, we believe in fair, equitable, and competitive compensation. We offer pay that reflects your skills, experience, education, and location. Beyond compensation, you'll benefit from a comprehensive rewards package designed to support your health, financial wellbeing, and long-term success. Belimo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:

Sei pronto a plasmare la qualità dei prodotti Belimo di domani fin dall’inizio? In questo ruolo, si agirà come voce di qualità nei progetti di sviluppo e cambiamento di prodotto globali, assicurando che la qualità è pianificata, i rischi sono gestiti presto, e i prodotti sono pronti a svolgere nel mondo reale.

Cosa farai

• Agire come leader di qualità e un unico punto di contatto per la qualità nei progetti di sviluppo e cambiamento di prodotto assegnati a livello globale, garantendo un allineamento ravvicinato con Project Managers, Innovazione, Ingegneria, Supply Chain, Produzione, appalti, Product Management e funzioni di qualità.

• Sviluppare, implementare e monitorare i piani di qualità e i concetti di controllo specifici del progetto in tutte le fasi del PCP, tra cui l'identificazione e la mitigazione del rischio proattivo.

• Contribuisci alle valutazioni dei rischi di prodotto e di processo come FMEA, assicurando l'implementazione di azioni di mitigazione e la loro efficacia verificata prima delle approvazioni dei cancelli.

• Specifiche di revisione, uscite di progettazione, piani di verifica e convalida e risultati, e la prontezza di produzione; fornire una chiara raccomandazione basata sulla qualità per le approvazioni PCP gate.

• Assicurarsi che le lezioni apprese, i dati di garanzia e le informazioni sulle prestazioni del campo sono sistematicamente integrati in nuovi e progetti di miglioramento per prevenire il ripetersi di problemi noti.

• Applicare e migliorare continuamente metodi, strumenti e modelli armonizzati di qualità del gruppo, promuovendo il loro uso coerente tra Hub, regioni e impianti di innovazione.

• Raccogliere, valutare e segnalare i dati delle prestazioni di qualità del progetto come difetti, rielaborazione e modifiche tardive; identificare le tendenze e avviare azioni correttive e preventive.

• Sostenere gli audit interni ed esterni e le valutazioni relative ai processi di sviluppo e di progetto, assicurando la chiusura tempestiva delle deviazioni e l'adesione alle norme ISO e interne.

Chi sei

• Laurea in Ingegneria Elettronica o una disciplina tecnica equivalente.

• Minimo 3-5 anni di esperienza come Ingegnere di Qualità del Progetto, nello sviluppo del prodotto, o in un ruolo paragonabile all'interno di un ambiente globale o multinazionale.

• Forte conoscenza pratica di strumenti e metodi di qualità, tra cui APQP, FMEA, PPAP e Problem Solving.

• Auditore interno o piombo certificato per ISO 9001; IATF 16949 o standard comparabili sono un vantaggio.

• Esperienza pratica con sistemi di gestione della qualità, metodologie di test e documentazione tecnica.

• Prove capacità di analizzare i processi, identificare le lacune e sviluppare piani di miglioramento attuabili.

• Esperienza di lavoro efficace in team interfunzionali e interregionali, con forti capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder.

• Inglese fluente; tedesco è un vantaggio. Una mentalità analitica, attenzione ai dettagli e fiducia nella navigazione in ambienti in evoluzione o ambigui sono essenziali.

Pronti per il prossimo passo? Non vediamo l'ora di sentirti.

Persone a Belimo

Gli edifici intelligenti iniziano con persone dedicate. Portiamo insieme persone di talento e adottiamo un ambiente per avere successo. A Belimo, il rispetto, la fiducia e il supporto nei dipartimenti aiutano le idee a muoversi rapidamente in soluzioni del mondo reale, perché raggiungeremo più insieme di quanto non potremmo mai soli.

Informazioni su Belimo

Belimo è leader del mercato globale nello sviluppo, produzione e vendita di dispositivi di campo per il controllo efficiente dell'energia dei sistemi di riscaldamento, ventilazione e climatizzazione. Il focus del nostro core business è sugli attuatori ammortizzatori, valvole di controllo, sensori e metri. Fondata nel 1975, la società è quotata sulla Borsa Svizzera (SIX) dal 1995.

Compensazioni e vantaggi

A Belimo, crediamo in una compensazione equa, equa e competitiva. Offriamo la paga che riflette le vostre abilità, esperienza, istruzione e posizione. Oltre al compenso, potrai beneficiare di un pacchetto completo di ricompense progettato per supportare la tua salute, il benessere finanziario e il successo a lungo termine. Belimo è orgoglioso di essere un Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
Einführung

Gemeinsam mit einem hochmotivierten Team entwickelst du Mixed-Signal-ASICs, die das Herzstück jedes Belimo-Antriebs und -Sensors bilden und millionenfach produziert werden. Dabei übernimmst du die technische Verantwortung für den Analogteil, der von unserem ASIC-Lieferanten extern entwickelt wird.

Hauptverantwortlichkeiten

• Spezifikation und Verifikation des Analogteils unserer ASICs

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem ASIC-Lieferanten sowie gemeinsames Lösen technischer Herausforderungen bei der Entwicklung des Analogteils

• Technische Schnittstelle zum internen Team für den Digitalteil sowie zum Systemverifikationsteam, das die ASICs innerhalb von Belimo-Geräten prüft

• Entwicklung und Pflege von Leiterplatten für die Entwicklung und Qualifizierung der ASICs

• Analoges Schaltungsdesign neuer Funktionen

Erforderliche Fachkenntnisse

•
 Masterabschluss in Elektrotechnik, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Mikroelektronik oder Analogelektronik

•
 Mehrjährige Erfahrung im analogen Schaltungsdesign sowie in der Messtechnik, einschliesslich Requirements Engineering und Verifikationsmethoden

•
 Erfahrung im Bereich Mikroelektronik ist ein grosser Pluspunkt

•

jobs.description:
Einführung

Deine Chance, die Mechanik unserer Antriebe und Sensoren vom Konzept bis zur Serie zu verantworten.

Bei uns entwickelst du mechanische Komponenten und Module für Antriebe und Sensoren und übernimmst die technische Projektleitung im Fachbereich Mechanik. Dabei verbindest du technische Qualität, Wirtschaftlichkeit und Serientauglichkeit. Gemeinsam mit Fachpersonen verschiedener Disziplinen und externen Partnern klärst du komplexe Entwicklungsfragen.

Was wirst du tun

• Du entwickelst mechanische Komponenten und Module für Antriebe und Sensoren in der Gebäudeautomation.

• Aus den Systemanforderungen leitest du die mechanischen Anforderungen ab und erarbeitest und dokumentierst das Konzept-Design.

• Gemeinsam mit den Fachpersonen aus Elektronik, Architektur und Sensorik sowie den Product Ownern bewertest du technische Lösungen. Dabei wägst du Qualität, Kosten, Zeit und Risiken gegeneinander ab.

• In der technischen Projektleitung der Domain Mechanik setzt du Ziele, koordinierst die zugewiesenen Experten und stimmst Aufwände und Planung mit dem Projektmanagement ab.

• Anforderungen, Normen, Herstellbarkeit und Wirtschaftlichkeit stellst du sicher – in enger Abstimmung mit Projektmitarbeitenden aus verschiedenen Bereichen, wie auch mit den Lieferanten.

• Die Verifikation deiner Domain planst und koordinierst du, beurteilst den Reifegrad und treibst Serienfähigkeit und Freigabe voran.

• Fachliches Coaching und Mentoring der Domain Professionals im Mechanik Team.

• Mitarbeit bei Lifecycle- und Maintenance-Themen, bei Qualitätsfällen und bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Entwicklungsprozesse.

Wer du bist

• Technisches Studium auf Stufe Bachelor oder Master (FH, ETH oder Universität), z.B. in Maschinenbau, Mechatronik oder Feinwerktechnik.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction

Your chance to take responsibility for the mechanics of our drives and sensors from concept to series production.

With us, you develop mechanical components and modules for drives and sensors and take over the technical project management in the mechanical department. You combine technical quality, cost-effectiveness and series suitability. Together with experts from various disciplines and external partners, you will clarify complex development questions.

What will you do

• You develop mechanical components and modules for drives and sensors in building automation.

• From the system requirements, you derive the mechanical requirements and develop and document the concept design.

• Together with the experts from electronics, architecture and sensors as well as the product owners, you will evaluate technical solutions. You balance quality, costs, time and risks against each other.

• In the technical project management of Domain Mechanics, you set goals, coordinate the assigned experts and coordinate effort and planning with project management.

• You ensure requirements, standards, manufacturability and cost-effectiveness – in close coordination with project employees from different areas as well as with the suppliers.

• You plan and coordinate the verification of your domain, assess the maturity level and push forward serial capability and release.

• Professional coaching and mentoring of domain professionals in the mechanics team.

• Cooperation in lifecycle and maintenance issues, in quality cases and in the further development of our development processes.

Who you are

• Technical studies at Bachelor or Master level (FH, ETH or University), e.g. in mechanical engineering, mechatronics or precision engineering.

• You have many years of experience in mechanical development and verification of development results. You have gained this experience in a complex, multidisciplinary development environment, ideally in the manufacturing industry.

• Complex plastic injection-molded parts you know from several years of practice.

• You have experience in technical project management (dates, risks, resources, quality) and technical supplier management.

• A big plus would be your experience in gear design or the development of water-conducting components such as valves or flowbodies.

• For products in large quantities, you ensure mechanical quality. Manufacturability, assembly, robustness and the analysis of tolerance chains are part of your daily work.

• Safe handling of 3D CAD (ideally Siemens NX), FEM simulation and relevant standards (ISO-GPS, UL). Experience with DFMEA, SAP and PLM systems is an advantage.

• You are a goal-oriented, pragmatic personality, lead professionally even without formal line responsibility and create clarity about what needs to be achieved.

• Very good knowledge of English; Knowledge of German at a good level is desirable, especially for internal communication.

We look forward to meeting you.

People at Belimo

Intelligent buildings are created by committed people. We bring talented people together and create an environment where they can succeed. At Belimo, respect, trust and mutual support across departmental boundaries help turn ideas quickly into practical solutions. Together we achieve more than we could ever achieve alone.

About Belimo

Belimo is the world market leader in the development, manufacture and sale of field devices for energy-efficient control of heating, ventilation and air conditioning systems. Flap drives, control valves, sensors and meters form our core business. Founded in 1975, the company has been listed on the Swiss Stock Exchange (SIX) since 1995.

Remuneration and additional benefits

At Belimo, we believe in fair, fair and competitive compensation. We offer a salary that matches your skills, experience, education and location. In addition to the compensation, you benefit from comprehensive additional services that support your mental, physical, financial and social well-being. Belimo is proud to be an employer promoting equal opportunities.

Introduzione

Insieme agli stakeholder locali e globali, garantisci che i requisiti legali, gli standard aziendali e le pratiche HSE sostenibili siano efficacemente ancorati nella vita lavorativa quotidiana. In questo ruolo, svolgi una funzione centrale di consulenza e controllo, rafforzi la cultura della sicurezza e fornisci un contributo visibile al benessere dei nostri dipendenti e allo sviluppo sostenibile della nostra sede.

Principali responsabilità

- Ulteriore sviluppo della strategia HSE per il sito e miglioramento continuo delle prestazioni in materia di salute, sicurezza e ambiente.
- Responsabilità per l'ulteriore sviluppo del sistema di gestione integrato (ISO 14001 / ISO 45001) nel rispetto delle direttive del gruppo e dei requisiti di legge.
- Referente centrale per autorità, auditor ed enti esterni, nonché accompagnamento di ispezioni, audit e certificazioni.
- Conduzione di analisi dei rischi, valutazioni ambientali e indagini su incidenti e incidenti, compresa la garanzia di misure efficaci.
- Promuovere una cultura della sicurezza sostenibile attraverso corsi di formazione, misure di sensibilizzazione e una stretta collaborazione con dirigenti e dipendenti.
- Sviluppo e coordinamento dei processi di gestione delle emergenze e delle crisi e organizzazione delle relative esercitazioni.
- Garantire un reporting HSE significativo e una partecipazione attiva alle iniziative HSE a livello di gruppo e allo scambio di best practice.

Competenze richieste

- Formazione professionale completata con perfezionamento e qualifica come specialista:in ASGS o esperto:in ASGS.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction

As HSE Manager, you actively shape health, occupational safety and the environment at our industrial and logistics site in Hinwil. Together with local and global stakeholders, you ensure that legal requirements, corporate standards and sustainable HSE practices are effectively anchored in everyday work. In this role, you take on a central advisory and control function, strengthen the safety culture and make a visible contribution to the well-being of our employees and to the sustainable development of our site.

Main responsibilities

- Further development of the HSE strategy for the site as well as continuous improvement of health, safety and environmental performance.
- Responsibility for the further development of the Integrated Management System (ISO 14001 / ISO 45001) in compliance with Group requirements and legal requirements.
- Central contact person for authorities, auditors and external bodies as well as monitoring inspections, audits and certifications.
- Management of risk analyses, environmental assessments, incident and accident investigations, including ensuring effective measures.
- Promote a sustainable culture of safety through training, awareness-raising and close cooperation with managers and employees.
- Development and coordination of emergency and crisis management processes and organisation of appropriate exercises.
- Ensure meaningful HSE reporting and active cooperation in group-wide HSE initiatives and in the exchange of best-practices.

Skills required

- Completed vocational training with further training and the qualification as a specialist:in ASGS or Expert:in ASGS.
- Several years of experience in the HSE environment of an industrial or logistics company, excellent communication skills in German and English, and a strong proximity to operational business. High presence on site and the ability to work closely with the operational teams.
- Well-founded experience in the development, development and auditing of management systems according to ISO 14001 and ISO 45001.
- Very good knowledge of Swiss legislation in the areas of occupational safety, health protection, environmental management and compliance.
- Experience in handling HSE indicators, reporting systems and digital tools, especially Microsoft 365 and HSE software.
- Extensive leadership, communication and persuasion skills combined with a pragmatic and solution-oriented approach.
- Integrative and tycoon personality with high ownership, prioritization strength and a passion for safety culture and continuous improvement.
- Negotiable German knowledge and good English skills.

People at Belimo

Intelligent buildings are created by committed people. We bring together talented people and create an environment in which they can be successful. At Belimo, respect, trust and mutual support across departmental boundaries help make ideas quickly practical solutions. Together, we achieve more than we could ever achieve on our own.

About Belimo

Belimo is the world leader in the development, manufacture and distribution of field equipment for energy-efficient control of heating, ventilation and air conditioning systems. Valve drives, control valves, sensors and counters form our core business. Founded in 1975, Belimo has been listed on the Swiss Stock Exchange (SIX) since 1995.

Compensation and additional services

We at Belimo believe in fair, just and competitive remuneration. We offer a salary that matches your skills, experience, training and where you are. In addition to the remuneration, you benefit from comprehensive benefits that support your mental, physical, financial and social well-being. Belimo is proud to be an employer that promotes equal opportunities.

Introduction

Join us as an Embedded Security Verification Engineer and play a key role in securing next-generation embedded and IoT products. You will lead security testing, identify vulnerabilities, and build automated validation solutions for ARM-based firmware platforms while collaborating across development and security teams.

Schließen Sie sich uns als Embedded Security Verification Engineer an und spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Sicherung von Embedded- und IoT-Produkten der nächsten Generation. Sie leiten Sicherheitstests, identifizieren Schwachstellen und erstellen automatisierte Validierungslösungen für ARM-basierte Firmware-Plattformen, während Sie in Entwicklungs- und Sicherheitsteams zusammenarbeiten.

• Praktische Erfahrung in der Schwachstellenbewertung und Penetrationstests von Kommunikationsstacks (REST APIs, HTTP, Modbus, BACnet usw.).

• Starke Programmierkenntnisse in Embedded C++ und Python.

• Verständnis der Grundlagen der Kryptographie, einschließlich Verschlüsselung, digitaler Signaturen, PKI und Schlüsselmanagement.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Présentation

Rejoignez-nous en tant qu'ingénieur de vérification de sécurité embarqué et jouez un rôle clé dans la sécurisation des produits embarqués et IoT de nouvelle génération. Vous dirigerez les tests de sécurité, identifierez les vulnérabilités et créerez des solutions de validation automatisées pour les plates-formes de firmware basées sur ARM tout en collaborant entre les équipes de développement et de sécurité.

Principales responsabilités

• Planifier, documenter et diriger des campagnes de tests de sécurité pour les produits embarqués.

• Effectuer des évaluations de sécurité, des tests de pénétration, des modélisations de menace et des examens de sécurité.

• Valider les fonctions de sécurité critiques telles que les protocoles Secure Boot, Secure Update, Secure Storage et Communication.

• Identifier et analyser les vulnérabilités dans le firmware, les piles de communication et les systèmes embarqués.

• Concevoir, développer et maintenir des cadres automatisés d'essais et de validation de sécurité.

• Coordonner les partenaires extérieurs de développement et prendre en charge certains produits livrables.

• Soutenir les versions de firmware, les activités de maintenance et les exigences de conformité en matière de sécurité.

• Étudier les défauts de sécurité signalés et contribuer aux efforts de remise en état de la vulnérabilité.

Expertise requise

• B.Sc. ou M.Sc. en génie logiciel, en informatique, en génie électrique et informatique ou dans un domaine connexe; les certifications de cybersécurité sont également appréciées.

• Expérience avec les systèmes intégrés axés sur la cybersécurité et les architectures sécurisées du firmware.

• Expérience pratique dans l'évaluation de la vulnérabilité et les tests de pénétration des piles de communication (API REST, HTTP, Modbus, BACnet, etc.).

• Connaissance de technologies intégrées sécurisées, y compris un démarrage sécurisé, une mise à jour sécurisée, un logiciel fiable et des concepts de stockage sécurisé.

• Fortes compétences en programmation en C++ embarqué et en Python.

• Comprendre les fondamentaux de la cryptographie, y compris le chiffrement, les signatures numériques, l'ICP et la gestion des clés.

• Expérience des environnements RTOS, des protocoles réseau, des bus de terrain industriels et des outils d'automatisation de test tels que Robot Framework.

• Compétences de communication en anglais; l'allemand est un plus.

Les gens de Belimo

Les bâtiments intelligents commencent par des personnes dédiées. Nous réunissons des gens talentueux et nous favorisons un environnement propice à la réussite. Chez Belimo, le respect, la confiance et le soutien à travers les ministères aident les idées à passer rapidement à des solutions concrètes, parce que nous obtenons plus ensemble que nous ne le pouvions jamais.

À propos de Belimo

Belimo est le leader mondial dans le développement, la production et la vente de dispositifs de terrain pour le contrôle énergétique des systèmes de chauffage, de ventilation et de climatisation. Nos activités principales sont les actionneurs d'amortisseurs, les vannes de commande, les capteurs et les compteurs. Fondée en 1975, la société est cotée à la Bourse suisse (SIX) depuis 1995.

Rémunération et avantages sociaux

Chez Belimo, nous croyons en une rémunération juste, équitable et concurrentielle. Nous offrons une rémunération qui reflète vos compétences, votre expérience, vos études et votre emplacement. Au-delà de la rémunération, vous bénéficierez d'un ensemble complet de récompenses conçu pour soutenir votre santé, votre bien-être financier et votre succès à long terme. Belimo est fier d'être un employeur pour l'égalité des chances.

Persone a Belimo

Gli edifici intelligenti sono creati da persone impegnate. Portiamo insieme persone di talento e creiamo un ambiente in cui possono avere successo. About Belimo

Belimo è leader mondiale nello sviluppo, nella produzione e nella vendita di dispositivi di campo per il controllo efficiente dell'impianto di riscaldamento, ventilazione e condizionamento dell'aria. Belimo è orgogliosa di essere un datore di lavoro che promuove pari opportunità.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction

In this versatile function, you are the central contact person for our customers and partners in Switzerland at our location in Granges-Paccot (Fribourg).

You process inquiries independently and thus contribute to a high customer satisfaction on a daily basis.

You take on an important connection function between the customers, sales and internal departments. Whether complex HVAC applications, technical offers or demanding product inquiries: You bring your expertise and ensure that challenges become successful solutions.

This role suits you if you like to solve technical challenges, enjoy daily customer contact and want to directly shape sales success with your contribution.

Main responsibilities

• Advising and supporting our business partners and customers across our entire product range – by phone or email.

• Independent processing of customer application and offer requests with needs-based support from product management.

• Participate in the successful introduction of new products and ensure the availability of current sales tools

• Technical support of our field team.

• Actively contribute your experience from customer inquiries in order to continuously develop technical support, processes, documentation and tools.

Required expertise

• Completed vocational apprenticeship in the HVAC, building automation or electrical industry.

• In-depth practical experience in the HVAC and/or building automation industry and you already have several years of experience in customer support.

• French mother tongue and very good knowledge of German.

• Secure handling of common Microsoft Office applications.

• You enjoy working in a team and building constructive relationships with customers, sales colleagues and internal specialists.

• Readiness for occasional travel and representation tasks.

People at Belimo

Intelligent buildings are created by committed people. We bring talented people together and create an environment where they can succeed. At Belimo, respect, trust and mutual support across departmental boundaries help turn ideas quickly into practical solutions. Together we achieve more than we could ever achieve alone.

About Belimo

Belimo is the world market leader in the development, manufacture and sale of field devices for energy-efficient control of heating, ventilation and air conditioning systems. Flap drives, control valves, sensors and meters form our core business. Founded in 1975, the company has been listed on the Swiss Stock Exchange (SIX) since 1995.

Remuneration and additional benefits

At Belimo, we believe in fair, fair and competitive compensation. We offer a salary that matches your skills, experience, education and location. In addition to the compensation, you benefit from comprehensive additional services that support your mental, physical, financial and social well-being. Belimo is proud to be an employer promoting equal opportunities.

Dans ce rôle, vous êtes responsable du développement technique et de l'exploitation de notre plateforme PIM Centric/Contentserv. Avec les départements internes, le gestionnaire d'applications fonctionnels et les 177 partenaires externes, vous assurez une exploitation stable et développez des solutions orientées vers l'avenir pour nos processus d'information et de publication sur les produits.

Principales responsabilités

- Responsabilité technique de notre plateforme PIM Centric/Contentserv en étroite collaboration avec le gestionnaire d'applications fonctionnels et 177 partenaires externes.
- Assurer un fonctionnement stable et prendre en charge le support de 3ème niveau en analysant, débogant et coordonnant les ajustements nécessaires dans le code PHP.
- Développement de la plate-forme PIM en ce qui concerne les nouvelles versions et les approches modernes de déploiement.
- Conception et mise en œuvre de solutions PIM prospectives et performantes, y compris des connexions aux systèmes de re-système (par exemple ERP et environnement web) et aux exportations de clients.
- Conseiller les ministères internes sur les sujets du GIP et les processus de publication connexes.
- Offrir une formation et promouvoir la mise en valeur des connaissances sur les nouveaux processus et technologies logiciels.

Compétences requises

- Formation en tant qu'ingénieur informatique avec une formation complémentaire en développement de logiciels ou une qualification comparable.
- Une connaissance bien fondée de PHP et des web-frameworks modernes. La connaissance d'autres langages de programmation et des technologies de feuille de style est un avantage.
- Expérience dans le fonctionnement des applications basées sur des conteneurs ainsi que avec les concepts d'infrastructure comme code. La connaissance des plateformes hyperscalers est un avantage.
- Bonne connaissance des processus modernes de développement de logiciels, en particulier DevOps, CI/CD et les méthodes de développement de l'entreprise.
- Profitez de la coopération dans une petite équipe de spécialistes, de l'échange avec des collègues internationaux ainsi que de l'évaluation et de la mise en œuvre de nouvelles technologies.
- Une grande initiative, une flexibilité et une manière de travailler structurée et orientée vers la solution.
- Très bonnes compétences en anglais en paroles et en écriture. Les compétences en allemand sont d'avantage.

jobs.description:
Introduction

Shape product compliance from requirements through approval and lifecycle. As a Product Compliance Engineer, you will independently lead compliance activities across assigned products and regulations, serving as the go-to expert for projects and critical issues. You’ll work across engineering teams and with external authorities to turn regulatory requirements into practical solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead product compliance activities and independently manage approvals, audits, and inspections.

• Ensure products, technical documentation, and processes comply with applicable regulations, directives, and standards.

• Define, challenge, and approve regulatory requirements and product compliance information.

• Serve as the subject-matter expert for compliance topics in development projects and customer-critical escalations.

• Lead regional registrations and approvals, collaborating with authorities and notified bodies.

• Monitor regulatory and standards developments and translate changes into actionable product and process requirements.

• Coordinate cross-functional initiatives to embed regulatory requirements into product design, development, and lifecycle processes.

• Contribute to relevant standardization committees where appropriate.

Required Expertise

• Bachelor’s degree in electronics engineering, engineering, or another relevant technology-related field, or an equivalent higher technical qualification.

• Several years of experience in compliance engineering or a comparable role, with demonstrated ability to handle complex compliance topics independently.

• Deep knowledge of product regulations, directives, and technical standards, particularly EMC and electrical safety.

• Ability to translate regulatory requirements into concrete technical and organizational actions.

• Strong technical writing and documentation skills.

• Very good English and strong communication skills for collaboration with technical teams and external stakeholders.

• Reliable, self-organized, and proactive, with a strong willingness to continuously learn.

• Advanced or further professional training is an advantage.

People at Belimo

Smart buildings start with dedicated people. We bring talented people together and foster an environment to succeed. At Belimo, respect, trust, and support across departments help ideas move quickly into real-world solutions, because we achieve more together than we ever could alone.

About Belimo

Belimo is the global market leader in the development, production, and sales of field devices for the energy-efficient control of heating, ventilation and air-conditioning systems. The focus of our core business is on damper actuators, control valves, sensors and meters. Founded in 1975, the company has been listed on the Swiss Exchange (SIX) since 1995.

Compensation & Benefits

At Belimo, we believe in fair, equitable, and competitive compensation. We offer pay that reflects your skills, experience, education, and location. Beyond compensation, you'll benefit from a comprehensive rewards package designed to support your health, financial wellbeing, and long-term success. Belimo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione

Formare la conformità del prodotto dai requisiti attraverso l'approvazione e il ciclo di vita. In qualità di Product Compliance Engineer, guiderai in modo indipendente le attività di conformità tra i prodotti e i regolamenti assegnati, servendo come esperto per progetti e questioni critiche. Potrai lavorare in team di ingegneria e con autorità esterne per trasformare i requisiti normativi in soluzioni pratiche.

Principali responsabilità

• Guidare le attività di conformità del prodotto e gestire in modo indipendente le approvazioni, gli audit e le ispezioni.

• Assicurare prodotti, documentazione tecnica e processi conformi alle normative, direttive e norme applicabili.

• Definire, sfidare e approvare i requisiti normativi e le informazioni sulla conformità del prodotto.

• Servire come esperto soggetto-materia per gli argomenti di conformità nei progetti di sviluppo e le escalation critiche del cliente.

• Condurre registrazioni e approvazioni regionali, collaborando con le autorità e gli organismi notificati.

• Monitorare gli sviluppi normativi e standard e tradurre i cambiamenti nei requisiti di prodotto e processo attuabili.

• Coordinate le iniziative interfunzionali per integrare i requisiti normativi nei processi di progettazione, sviluppo e ciclo di vita dei prodotti.

• Contribuire a comitati di standardizzazione pertinenti, se del caso.

Competenza richiesta

• Laurea in ingegneria elettronica, ingegneria, o un altro campo relativo alla tecnologia rilevante, o una qualifica tecnica superiore equivalente.

• Diversi anni di esperienza nell'ingegneria di conformità o un ruolo paragonabile, con la capacità dimostrata di gestire argomenti di conformità complessi indipendentemente.

• Conoscenza profonda delle normative, direttive e norme tecniche dei prodotti, in particolare EMC e sicurezza elettrica.

• Capacità di tradurre i requisiti normativi in azioni tecniche e organizzative concrete.

• Forte capacità di scrittura tecnica e documentazione.

• Molto buone capacità di comunicazione inglese e forte per la collaborazione con team tecnici e stakeholder esterni.

• Affidabile, auto-organizzato e proattivo, con una forte volontà di imparare continuamente.

• La formazione professionale avanzata o successiva è un vantaggio.

Persone a Belimo

Gli edifici intelligenti iniziano con persone dedicate. Portiamo insieme persone di talento e adottiamo un ambiente per avere successo. A Belimo, il rispetto, la fiducia e il supporto nei dipartimenti aiutano le idee a muoversi rapidamente in soluzioni del mondo reale, perché raggiungeremo più insieme di quanto non potremmo mai soli.

Informazioni su Belimo

Belimo è leader del mercato globale nello sviluppo, produzione e vendita di dispositivi di campo per il controllo efficiente dell'energia dei sistemi di riscaldamento, ventilazione e climatizzazione. Il focus del nostro core business è sugli attuatori ammortizzatori, valvole di controllo, sensori e metri. Fondata nel 1975, la società è quotata sulla Borsa Svizzera (SIX) dal 1995.

Compensazioni e vantaggi

A Belimo, crediamo in una compensazione equa, equa e competitiva. Offriamo la paga che riflette le vostre abilità, esperienza, istruzione e posizione. Oltre al compenso, potrai beneficiare di un pacchetto completo di ricompense progettato per supportare la tua salute, il benessere finanziario e il successo a lungo termine. Belimo è orgoglioso di essere un Equal Opportunity Employer.

Sie arbeiten in allen Engineering-Teams und mit externen Behörden zusammen, um regulatorische Anforderungen in praktische Lösungen umzusetzen.

Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten

• Leiten Sie die Compliance-Aktivitäten für Produkte und verwalten Sie unabhängig Genehmigungen, Audits und Inspektionen.

• Definieren, fordern und genehmigen Sie regulatorische Anforderungen und Produktkonformitätsinformationen.

• Als Fachexperte für Compliance-Themen in Entwicklungsprojekten und kundenkritischen Eskalationen.

• Führen Sie regionale Registrierungen und Zulassungen in Zusammenarbeit mit Behörden und benannten Stellen.

• Überwachung von regulatorischen und Normungsentwicklungen und Umsetzung von Änderungen in umsetzbare Produkt- und Prozessanforderungen.

• Koordinieren Sie funktionsübergreifende Initiativen, um regulatorische Anforderungen in Produktdesign-, Entwicklungs- und Lebenszyklusprozesse einzubetten.

• gegebenenfalls Beiträge zu den einschlägigen Normungsausschüssen.

Erforderliches Fachwissen

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Elektroniktechnik, Ingenieurwesen oder einem anderen relevanten technologiebezogenen Bereich oder einer gleichwertigen höheren technischen Qualifikation.

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Compliance Engineering oder eine vergleichbare Rolle, mit nachgewiesener Fähigkeit, komplexe Compliance-Themen selbstständig zu behandeln.

• Tiefe Kenntnisse der Produktvorschriften, Richtlinien und technischen Normen, insbesondere EMV und elektrische Sicherheit.

• Fähigkeit, regulatorische Anforderungen in konkrete technische und organisatorische Maßnahmen umzusetzen.

• Starke technische Schreib- und Dokumentationsfähigkeiten.

• Sehr gutes Englisch und starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten für die Zusammenarbeit mit technischen Teams und externen Stakeholdern.

• Zuverlässig, selbstorganisiert und proaktiv, mit einer starken Bereitschaft, kontinuierlich zu lernen.

• Fort- oder Weiterbildung ist von Vorteil.

Bei Belimo helfen Respekt, Vertrauen und Unterstützung über Abteilungen hinweg, Ideen schnell in reale Lösungen zu bringen, weil wir gemeinsam mehr erreichen, als wir es jemals alleine könnten.

Über Belimo

Belimo ist Weltmarktführer in der Entwicklung, Produktion und dem Vertrieb von Feldgeräten zur energieeffizienten Steuerung von Heizungs-, Lüftungs- und Klimaanlagen. Der Fokus unseres Kerngeschäfts liegt auf Dämpferaktoren, Regelventilen, Sensoren und Zählern. Das 1975 gegründete Unternehmen ist seit 1995 an der Swiss Exchange (SIX) notiert.

Entschädigung und Vorteile

Former la conformité du produit à partir des exigences jusqu'à l'approbation et au cycle de vie. En tant qu'ingénieur de la conformité des produits, vous dirigerez de manière indépendante les activités de conformité dans les produits et les règlements qui vous sont assignés, en tant qu'expert en projets et en enjeux critiques. Principales responsabilités

• Définir, contester et approuver les exigences réglementaires et les renseignements sur la conformité des produits.

• Servir d'expert en matière de conformité dans les projets de développement et les escalades critiques des clients.

• Coordonner les initiatives interfonctionnelles afin d'intégrer les exigences réglementaires à la conception, au développement et au cycle de vie des produits.

• Contribuer, le cas échéant, aux comités de normalisation compétents.

Expertise requise

• Baccalauréat en ingénierie électronique, en ingénierie ou dans un autre domaine technologique pertinent, ou une qualification technique supérieure équivalente.

• Plusieurs années d'expérience en ingénierie de la conformité ou un rôle comparable, avec une capacité démontrée de traiter des sujets de conformité complexes indépendamment.

• Connaissance approfondie de la réglementation des produits, des directives et des normes techniques, en particulier de la CEM et de la sécurité électrique.

• Capacité de traduire les exigences réglementaires en mesures techniques et organisationnelles concrètes.

• Fortes compétences techniques en rédaction et documentation.

• Très bonnes compétences en anglais et en communication pour la collaboration avec les équipes techniques et les intervenants externes.

• Fiable, auto-organisée et proactive, avec une forte volonté d'apprendre continuellement.

• La formation professionnelle avancée ou continue est un avantage.

Les gens de Belimo

Les bâtiments intelligents commencent par des gens dévoués. Nous réunissons des gens talentueux et favorisons un environnement propice à la réussite.
